visual_overrides.core_identity: The animated skeleton of a minotaur, preserving the horned bull skull and massive humanoid bone structure without flesh.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Tall skeletal humanoid frame topped by a broad horned bull skull with large ribs and long limb bones.
visual_overrides.head_features: Large bovine skull with long muzzle cavity, empty eye sockets, and prominent curved horns.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Heavy humanoid skeleton with broad rib cage and large limb bones, clearly larger than a human skeleton.
visual_overrides.surface: Clean bone shapes with sparse cracks and no gore or hanging flesh.
signature_gear: simple damaged axe or labyrinth weapon
